featured_reviews.name: SHIVAM RANAWAT
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star Review

Absolutely disappointed and frustrated with my experience at this bike accessories store. I trusted them with my helmet something that’s not just expensive, but also very personal and crucial for my safety and I honestly regret that decision now.

I had given my helmet to them to get it professionally painted, expecting quality work, attention to detail, and basic professionalism. What I got instead was a ruined helmet with poor finishing, uneven paintwork, and scratches that weren’t even there when I handed it over. The helmet looks far worse than when I gave it in, and they’ve completely destroyed its original look.

When I tried to politely raise my concerns and explain that this was not what I paid for, I was met with complete arrogance and abuse from the owner. Rather than being apologetic or trying to fix the situation, he became aggressive, loud, and extremely disrespectful, as if I was the one at fault for expecting a decent job. There was no sense of accountability or customer service.

It’s sad that some businesses think they can treat their customers this way and get away with it. I’m sharing this review to warn others if you’re thinking of giving them your helmet or any of your gear for customization or servicing, please think twice. There are plenty of other stores out there who will treat you with respect and deliver what they promise. This is not one of them.

I don’t usually write negative reviews, but this experience was just too unprofessional and upsetting to ignore.
